messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT | Antlia (Enterprise) — Partial routing failures observed for Dedicated pools in us-west-2. Error spike (502/504) starting ~1719998800. Paging on-call: @alex.nguyen :rotating_light:

alex.nguyen: taking this. acknowledging page. spinning up triage now — tagging SRE lead.

maria.perez: seeing increased 5xx from gateway -> backend-proxy in us-west-2, ~35% of requests failing, some retries bumping latency. can share affected accounts shortly.

jordan: adding logs snippet from edge node 3 (truncated):
```
2024-06-12T14:21:03Z ERR upstream request failed status=502 route=/v1/generate conn=54
2024-06-12T14:21:04Z WARN kvcache miss seq=1024
```

alex.nguyen: thanks. @customer-success-anya — can you pull the enterprise list for Dedicated customers pinned to us-west-2? we need contact routing and who to notify.

customer-success-anya: pulling now. preliminary list: Antlia Health (antlia@ops), Kestrel Financial (infra-eng@kestrel), HelixP (support@helixp-enterprise). Antlia Health has SLA and active incident channel.

sre-lead: initial hypothesis: a recent autoscaler config change caused gateway pods to scale down under load, causing 502 cascades. rolling back scaler should reduce 502s. can we do canary rollback to previous replica target?

alex.nguyen: agree. will execute a targeted rollback on gateway-deployment.us-west-2 -> replicas=6 (prev value 12). doing canary rollback to 12 on node-pool-a. @ops-bot kick off rollback now.

ops-bot: Command accepted: rollback gateway-deployment.us-west-2 replicas=12. ETA ~2m.

oncall-bot: STATUS UPDATE: Mitigation in progress — scaling rollback initiated. Affected region: us-west-2. Impact: Elevated 5xx for Dedicated customers in region. Next update in 10m or on change.

maria.perez: rollback confirmed by autoscaler metrics — replica count back to 12, pods stabilized. 5xx rate dropping to ~8% and latency normalizing. continuing observation.

alex.nguyen: drafting customer-facing impact note for Antlia Health and other affected enterprise customers. please review and sign off: 
```
Subject: Redwood Inference — Incident impacting Dedicated workloads in us-west-2

Hi <Customer Team>,

We experienced a partial routing and request failure impacting Dedicated inference pools in us-west-2 between 14:20–14:32 UTC. Root cause: an autoscaler configuration regression caused gateway capacity to be under-provisioned during a traffic spike, leading to transient 502/504 errors. Mitigation: we rolled back the autoscaler target and restored normal replica counts; production metrics show request success rates returning to baseline.\n
Impact: Some inference requests may have failed or taken longer to complete during the window. If you observed errors or elevated latency, please share timestamps and request IDs and we will investigate.\n
Action items: We are initiating a post-incident config audit and will push a config validation check to prevent re-deploying the bad scaler value. We will follow up with a detailed RCA within 48 hours.\n
Apologies for the interruption — we understand the impact and are treating this with high priority.

— Redwood Inference Ops\n```

customer-success-anya: LGTM. Suggest adding a tailored line for Antlia Health: "We did not see any data exposure; request payloads were intact. Your SLA credits will be evaluated per the incident window."

alex.nguyen: added. also preparing a brief status page blurb. proposed text:
```
Status: Partial service disruption for Dedicated inference in us-west-2. Mitigation: automated rollback applied, service recovering. Affected customers: selected Dedicated accounts in the region. Estimated full recovery: now.
```

oncall-bot: ACTION: Notify Antlia Health primary contact and open their enterprise channel. Paging routing: primary ops contact + escalation to account exec if no ack in 15m.

customer-success-anya: message sent to Antlia ops (antlia@ops) and Kestrel infra. Antlia confirmed receipt and reported a small number of failed inference jobs; they requested request ID list (we provided).

jordan: collecting request IDs for Antlia (sample): req_0a1b2c, req_0d3e4f. sharing logs to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1719998888/antlia-logs.log

alex.nguyen: handing off to @sre-lead for post-mitigation monitoring and RCA. I'll update on-call rotation and add remediation checklist to incident tracker.

sre-lead: taking over. next steps: full config audit, add preflight check in CI, run load test against gateway-proxy in staging with autoscaler anomalies. ETA for initial RCA draft: 36-48 hours.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (resolved): Gateway replicas restored, error rate reduced to baseline. Monitoring window: 60m. Incident severity: Sev2. Incident channel remains open for customer follow-ups.

alex.nguyen: thanks team. closing loop with Antlia: sent follow-up with request IDs and next steps. will attach final RCA to the enterprise ticket once ready. :white_check_mark:
